🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No student surveillance without explicit consent under UK GDPR and Education Act safeguards
  • ❌ No academic freedom infringement — AI governance must protect institutional autonomy under Education Reform Act 1988
  • ❌ No student finance decision without right of appeal and human review of exceptional circumstances
  • ❌ No research integrity assessment without Research England and UKRI oversight protocols
  • ❌ No widening access metric without contextual socioeconomic analysis and equality impact assessment
  • ❌ No international student data processing without immigration data sharing agreement and adequacy assessment

🤝 5-Step Engagement Model

1
Discovery: Map DFE higher education maturity across quality, research, and student finance domains. Identify regulatory gaps. Benchmark against allied international HE systems. Assess OfS compliance landscape.
2
Governance Design: Deploy DEFONEOS MCP servers against DFE use cases. Configure HE quality and research compliance. Establish DFE-OfS-UKRI oversight protocols.
3
Pilot: Run 90-day pilot across 3 university clusters and 2 research councils. Measure quality assurance improvement. Collect DFE and OfS feedback.
4
Scale: Roll out across all DFE higher education transformation streams. Integrate with national student data systems. Deploy across research funding governance.
5
Assure: Continuous audit-grade HE governance reporting. Research transparency. Parliamentary evidence generation. Annual Education Select Committee review.
